name: Trump International Tower Las Vegas
positioning: Non-gaming, smoke-free hotel in a 64-story golden glass tower above the Las Vegas Strip, officially named Trump International Hotel Las Vegas
best_for: Travelers who want a Strip base without a casino
Groups or families wanting multi-bedroom suites with kitchens

facts.text: The hotel is non-gaming and smoke-free, situated high above the Las Vegas Strip.
The hotel is a 64-story tower of golden glass.
Guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Strip or the surrounding mountains.
Penthouse suites come in one-, two- and three-bedroom layouts.
The seventh-floor pool deck has a heated pool.
The Spa at Trump offers treatments for women, men and couples.
The spa is on the pool level, reached by the main elevators from the lobby.
Valet parking at the hotel is complimentary.
The DJT restaurant serves breakfast, lunch and dinner, and its adjacent lounge opens in the evenings for cocktails and small plates.
Room service is available throughout the day and night.
The fitness center overlooks the pool and has TechnoGym equipment.
The hotel is close to the Fashion Show Mall and the Las Vegas Convention Center.

highlights.text: The pool is lined with private air-conditioned cabanas with wet bars and plasma TVs.
Suites have kitchens that can be custom stocked through the Trump Attache service.
The multi-bedroom penthouse suites can sleep six people.
All guests have the use of a Trump Attache, an elevated concierge service, during their stay.
The Wynn, Encore, Venetian and Palazzo casinos are just across the street.

considerations.text: A working railroad runs behind the hotel, and depending on the room you may hear trains passing at night.
The hotel doesn't have a boisterous pool party scene.
WhataHotel notes there's no casino on site for gaming enthusiasts.
